fields.title: Miami Life, Volume 4, Number 17 (1927-05-21)
creator: Wen R. Phillips
subject: Politics and government—Florida—Dade County
Elections—Florida—Dade County
Pari-mutuel betting
Horse racing
County government—Miami Beach (Fla.)
Public utilities—Florida Power & Light Company
Electric power rates
Transportation—Miami metropolitan area
Civic improvement
Lions Clubs—Conventions
fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local political commentary urging voter engagement and criticizing Dade County legislators over refusal to allow referenda on pari-mutuel racing and creation of a proposed Miami Beach county. Coverage discusses Florida Power & Light Company and utility rates/holding-company control, transportation problems between Miami and Coral Gables, preparations for an upcoming Lions convention, and assorted local columns, letters to the editor, and advertisements.
